WITH station_avgs AS (
  SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as baseline
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  AVG(sa.station_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline_averages,
  AVG(sa.station_avg - b.baseline) as mean_excess
FROM station_avgs sa
CROSS JOIN baseline b
WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline
